Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The umpires and the players are back out in the middle. It will be Vishmi Gunarathne and Chamari Athapaththu to open the innings for Sri Lanka Women. Rachel Slater to begin proceedings with the ball. Let's play...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, just 59 runs needed for Sri Lanka Women to make it back-to-back wins in the warm-up matches and this could really propel them early on in the main event as well and the confidence will be high. Scotland Women have a good bowling unit and would look to employ their spinners in the next way possible. Stay tuned as the run chase is up next.

It was a trial by spin for Scotland Women and after opting to bat first, they lost 3 wickets for just a run and after that, it was very difficult to conjure up a fightback. Sarah Bryce though did manage to counter the bowlers but hardly anyone else even managed to get into double figures and they now have a very tough task ahead with the ball.

Another solid outing in the field for Sri Lanka Women and they have kept Scotland Women down to a meager total, one that they would be looking to gun down without much of a fuss. It was Udeshika Prabodani who set things up in the very first over with a couple of wickets and after that, the Lankans were just relentless. They dropped a couple of catches but in general, the catching was solid and the intensity in the field was amazing as they got a couple of run outs as well. All in all, a commanding first half of the game from the Asian Champions.
